title: Max Points on a Line Problem

content.problemStatement:
With an array of `points` where `points[i] = [xi, yi]` represents a point on the **X-Y** plane, output *the largest number of points that lie on the same straight line*.

**Example 1:**

![](https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/02/25/plane1.jpg)

```
Input: points = [[1,1],[2,2],[3,3]]
Output: 3
```

**Example 2:**

![](https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/02/25/plane2.jpg)

```
Input: points = [[1,1],[3,2],[5,3],[4,1],[2,3],[1,4]]
Output: 4
```

**Constraints:**

* `1 <= points.length <= 300`
* `points[i].length == 2`
* `-104 <= xi, yi <= 104`
* All the `points` are **unique**.
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]
